title: Routing rules
subtitle: Who reaches a person, who is refused, and who the assistant answers. The agent applies these when the phone goes live; until then this is the record it will read.
add_note: A rule matches one full number, or every number under a prefix ending in * — like +43720*. One rule per number: to change what a caller gets, move their rule.
column_pass_note: Straight to a person, never the assistant.
column_block_note: The call is refused before anyone hears it ring.
column_ai_note: The assistant answers, whatever the defaults say.
never_called: No call from this number is on record
error_invalid_pattern: A rule matches a full number like +43 664 123456, or a prefix ending in * like +43720*.
error_rule_exists: A rule for this number already exists. Move it instead of adding a second one.
error_offline_title: The server could not be reached
